calls.statement:
SELECT 
  f.vat_rate,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC

-- Verify VAT calculation by checking a sample of data
SELECT 
  f.vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross,
  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) as total_vat_charged,
  ROUND(AVG(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount), 2) as avg_vat_per_line
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC

-- Check what VAT classes produce the 0.2400 rate
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.vat_class,
  f.vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY p.vat_class, f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate DESC

-- Sample products with 0.2400 VAT rate
SELECT DISTINCT
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  p.category,
  p.vat_class,
  f.vat_rate,
  COUNT(*) as sales_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
  AND f.vat_rate = 0.2400
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate
LIMIT 5

  SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged

INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key

  AND f.sale_date >= '2024-08-26'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2024-09-22'
